description.zh:
是否自动支付订单，取值：

- **true**：自动支付订单。
- **false**：手动支付订单，详情请参见[手动续费包年包月实例](~~85052~~)。

> 默认值为**true**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- **true**: enables automatic payment.

- **false**: disables automatic payment. For more information, see [Renew an ApsaraDB for MongoDB subscription instance](~~85052~~).

> Default value: **true**.

description.zh:
到期后是否自动续费，取值：

- **true**：自动续费。
- **false**：手动续费。

> 默认值为**false**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

> Default value: **false**.
The business information. This is an additional parameter.

description.zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
- **default**或**null**（默认）：使用优惠券。
- **youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank**：不使用优惠券。

description.en: The subscription duration of the instance. Unit: months. Valid values: **1**, **2**, **3**, **4**, **5**, **6**, **7**, **8**, **9**, **12**, **24**, and **36**.

title.zh: 将按量付费实例转换为包年包月实例

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解MongoDB产品的收费方式和和和<props="china">[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/mongodb/detail)</props><props="intl">[价格](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/apsaradb-for-mongodb/pricing)</props>。

包年包月的实例无法转换为按量付费的实例，为避免浪费您的资源，请谨慎操作。


调用本接口时，实例必须满足以下条件：

- 实例状态为运行中。
- 实例的计费类型为按量付费。
- 实例没有未完成支付的转包年包月订单。
- 实例规格不能为历史规格（不再售卖的规格），历史规格列表请参见[实例规格表](~~57141~~)。

> 如需将历史规格实例转变为包年包月，请先调用[ModifyDBInstanceSpec](~~61816~~)或[ModifyNodeSpec](~~61923~~)接口变更实例规格。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, make sure that you understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/apsaradb-for-mongodb/pricing).

A subscription instance cannot be changed to a pay-as-you-go instance. To avoid wasting resources, proceed with caution.

Before you call this API operation, make sure that the ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance meets the following requirements:

- The instance is in the running state.

- The billing method of the instance is pay-as-you-go.

- The instance has no unpaid subscription orders.

- The instance type is available for purchase. For more information about unavailable instance types, see [Instance types](~~57141~~).

> To change the billing method of an instance whose instance type is no longer available to subscription, call the [ModifyDBInstanceSpec](~~61816~~) or [ModifyNodeSpec](~~61923~~) operation to first change the instance type.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds transform-to-pre-paid --instance-id dds-bp1366caac830000 --period 1 --auto-pay true --business-info '“ActivityId_:_000000000' --auto-renew true --coupon-no default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds TransformToPrePaid --region cn-hangzhou --CouponNo default --BusinessInfo '“ActivityId_:_000000000' --InstanceId 'dds-bp1366caac830000' --AutoRenew true --Period 1 --AutoPay true
